Within each group (dated, undated), keep the todos' original relative order (stable partition; do not sort dated items by date). Apply the ordering after any existing filtering (e.g. includeDone) and before passing to formatList. Do not mutate the input array, and do not change the order in which todos are saved to disk; this affects displayed output only. Signatures stay the same. Add unit tests covering this.

input.reason: This is a display-only ordering change in commands.list: a stable partition that puts dated items before undated ones. The request doesn't ask to sort by date within the dated group, so the original order is kept there.
